Let Claude use your browser.title: Claude can use Airc
Let Claude use your browser.detail: AI apps such as Claude Desktop and Claude Code can open pages, read them, click and type for you, in windows of their own. Airc asks once per app and never shows one your passwords.

What's new, in Airc itself.title: What's new, in Airc
What's new, in Airc itself.detail: After an update Airc tells you what changed, on a page like this one or as a small card in the sidebar. Choose which, or neither, in Settings › General.

A Feedback button in the sidebar.title: Feedback with pictures
A Feedback button in the sidebar.detail: The speech bubble at the bottom of the sidebar sends a note to the Airc team. Add up to five pictures by pasting, dropping, or capturing the window.

Copy a link from the sidebar.title: Copy link from the sidebar
Copy a link from the sidebar.detail: Every tab in the sidebar has a copy button next to its ×. Click it to copy the tab's link without switching to it.

New windows in full screen.title: Full-screen new windows
New windows in full screen.detail: When Airc is in full screen, ⌘N opens the new window in a full-screen Space of its own, instead of floating over the one you're in.

Arc import, complete.title: Complete Arc import
Arc import, complete.detail: Importing from Arc now also brings your saved logins, cookies and sites' stored data, so you stay signed in to your sites. It needs the Chromium engine.

Notes and Easels open in Peek.title: Notes and Easels in Peek
Notes and Easels open in Peek.detail: Click a note or an Easel in the Library and it opens in Peek, a window floating over your page, ready to edit. Open in Space puts it back in the sidebar.

The Command Bar opens instantly.title: Command Bar opens at once
The Command Bar opens instantly.detail: The Command Bar is the box where you type a site, a search, an open tab or a command. Press ⌘T anywhere and it now appears in the very next frame, so the first letters you type always land in it.

Splits sync between your Macs.title: Splits sync between Macs
Splits sync between your Macs.detail: A split shows two or more pages side by side in one tab. With iCloud Sync on, the splits you pinned or made Favorites now appear on your other Macs too, in the same order and sizes.

More app icons.title: Pick Airc's app icon
More app icons.detail: Choose the icon Airc shows in the Dock, the app switcher and the Finder: six of Airc's own, from Holographic to Sunset, Ocean, Midnight and Graphite. Your choice stays after updates.

Calendar previews.title: Calendar previews
Calendar previews.detail: Rest the pointer on a pinned Google Calendar or Outlook calendar tab to see today's and tomorrow's events without switching to it. Click an event to open it there.

Opens faster.title: Opens faster
Opens faster.detail: Airc's window now appears right away when you open it, instead of waiting for the ad and tracker blocker. Pages still wait for it, so nothing loads unprotected.

Clear Archive by age.title: Clear Archive by age
Clear Archive by age.detail: The Archive keeps the tabs Airc tidied away for you. You can now clear all of it, or only tabs older than 7 or 30 days, with Undo right after.

See a Boost's code first.title: See a Boost's code first
See a Boost's code first.detail: A Boost restyles or changes a website for you. When you add one someone shared, Airc shows its full code before anything runs, and a Boost with code starts switched off.

See what your AI agent is doing.title: Watch your AI agents
See what your AI agent is doing.detail: When Claude or another AI app uses Airc, its tabs appear in an Agents folder in the sidebar. Click one to watch it live, then take it over as your own tab or stop it. Settings › Agents › Activity lists what agents did.

What's New in Airc.title: What's New in Airc
What's New in Airc.detail: After an update, Airc opens this tab to explain each new thing, with a button that takes you to it. Choose a tab, a card in the sidebar, or nothing in Settings › General.

Dark mode reads better.title: Dark mode reads better
Dark mode reads better.detail: Text in dark mode now meets standard contrast in every Space colour, so labels, addresses and the Command Bar's rows are easier to read. Dark Spaces are a little deeper.

Tidy Downloads renames automatically.title: Automatic download names
Tidy Downloads renames automatically.detail: Turn on Rename automatically in Settings › AI › Downloads, and a download with an unclear name gets a clear one by itself, with Undo right after. It needs Apple Intelligence.

Share Quote.title: Share Quote
Share Quote.detail: Select a few words on a page and a Share Quote button shows under the address. Click it to copy a link that opens the page at that text. You can turn it off in Settings › General.

Connect Claude in one step.title: Connect Claude in one step
Connect Claude in one step.detail: Type "claude" in the Command Bar, or choose Help › Use Airc with Claude…, and Settings › Agents opens with Add to Claude Desktop first. Access then says whether an app has connected.

Calendar previews show Arc's hour grid a.title: Calendar hour grid
Calendar previews show Arc's hour grid a.detail: Rest the pointer on a pinned Google Calendar or Outlook tab to see the next hours as a grid, with overlapping meetings side by side, a line at the current time and tomorrow's events below.

Updates retry by themselves.title: Updates retry on their own
Updates retry by themselves.detail: If an update download stalls, Airc gives up after 20 seconds and quietly tries once more, so updates arrive without you doing anything.

Export All Easels.title: Export All Easels
Export All Easels.detail: The card at the top of Library › Easels saves every Easel as a web page in one ZIP, while you keep working. File › Export Easel… now lets you pick Image or Web Page.

Dark site icons stay visible.title: Dark icons stay visible
Dark site icons stay visible.detail: In a dark theme, a site icon that is itself dark, such as a black letter, now sits on a small light plate so it doesn't disappear into the sidebar.

What's New's Show me goes further.title: More Show me buttons
What's New's Show me goes further.detail: Show me on this page can now also open Settings › AI and Settings › Shortcuts, and each update can explain up to seven new things.

Use Airc from your other devices.title: Airc from other devices
Use Airc from your other devices.detail: Claude Code or another AI app on another computer on your Tailscale network can use Airc on this Mac. Turn it on and pair each device with a one-time code in Settings › Agents › Other devices; Revoke ends a device's access.

Calendar previews fit Arc's six hours.title: Six-hour calendar cards
Calendar previews fit Arc's six hours.detail: Rest the pointer on a pinned Google Calendar or Outlook tab to see six hours without scrolling. A Google or Outlook calendar Favorite now shows that calendar's own day, not your Mac's calendars.

Typing in the Command Bar is lighter aga.title: Lighter Command Bar typing
Typing in the Command Bar is lighter aga.detail: Each letter you type in the Command Bar takes less work, with the same results. Services from other apps, like "Ask Claude", no longer show up there as commands that do nothing.

AI apps see page headings.title: AI apps see page headings
AI apps see page headings.detail: When Claude or another AI app reads a page in Airc, it gets the page's headings with their levels, so it finds its way around long pages. Hidden headings are left out.

Update downloads come straight from airc.title: Steadier update downloads
Update downloads come straight from airc.detail: Airc's updates now download through aircbrowser.com itself instead of a separate storage host, so they no longer stall on some networks.

Fixed a crash when signing in with Googl.title: Google sign-in crash fixed
Fixed a crash when signing in with Googl.detail: With the Chromium engine, "Continue with Google" on sites such as Pinterest could quit Airc. Sign-in now opens Google's own sign-in window instead.

Bangs in the Command Bar.title: Bangs in the Command Bar
Bangs in the Command Bar.detail: Type a bang such as !yt cats, !gm Vienna or !gt hello in the Command Bar (⌘T) to search that site straight away. Your own Site Search shortcuts work as bangs too.

Sign in with Google works inside Airc.title: Sign in with Google
Sign in with Google works inside Airc.detail: On pages that use Chromium, "Continue with Google" shows Google's account chooser over the page again, so you pick an account right there instead of in a separate sign-in window.

Your Google or Outlook calendar drives J.title: Your calendar drives Join
Your Google or Outlook calendar drives J.detail: With Google Calendar or Outlook as a Favorite or pinned tab, Live Calendar's countdown, Join and ⌃⌘J use its events and call links (Meet, Zoom, Teams, Webex). Turn on Live Calendar in Settings › General.

Search suggestions no longer flicker.title: Steady search suggestions
Search suggestions no longer flicker.detail: While you type in the Command Bar, the suggestions under it stay in place until new ones replace them, instead of blinking away with every letter.

Restart to Update waits for busy pages.title: Restart waits for pages
Restart to Update waits for busy pages.detail: When you click Restart to Update, every page gets a few seconds to finish. If a tab has unsaved work, Airc shows you which one and asks: Restart Anyway or Cancel.

⇧⌘R hard refresh.title: ⇧⌘R everywhere
⇧⌘R hard refresh.detail: ⇧⌘R reloads a page without its cached files. It now also works in Little Airc and in an open Peek, and reloads the page in front of you.

Lighter and quieter.title: Lighter and quieter
Lighter and quieter.detail: With WebKit, Airc's main process uses far less memory after launch. Switching Spaces is smoother, and an idle Airc no longer wakes up on repeating timers.

Ask Claude or ChatGPT from the Command B.title: Ask AI in the Command Bar
Ask Claude or ChatGPT from the Command B.detail: Type a question or a prompt after ⌘T, press ↓↓ and Return: it opens in a new Claude or ChatGPT chat, signed in as you are. Pick the site, or Off, in Settings › AI › Command Bar › Ask AI.

Settings sync between your Macs.title: Settings sync between Macs
Settings sync between your Macs.detail: With iCloud sync on, the settings you change (theme, shortcuts, Site Searches, blocking and more) follow you to your other Macs; the later change wins. Each Mac keeps its own folders, Developer Mode and app approvals. Settings › Sync › Sync settings.

Signing in to a new profile from the sid.title: Sign in to a new profile
Signing in to a new profile from the sid.detail: When you sign in to Google from a new profile's sidebar card, the profile takes the account's picture and name, and the card offers Gmail, Calendar and Drive for that account as Favorites: Add or Skip.

The Feedback button sits next to +.title: Feedback, next to +
The Feedback button sits next to +.detail: The speech bubble in the sidebar's bottom row now sits just left of +, after your Space icons. Click it to send a note or pictures to the Airc team.

Airc Agent (beta).title: Airc Agent (beta)
Airc Agent (beta).detail: Press ⌥⌘A, describe a task, and Airc does it in your signed-in sites with your own Anthropic or OpenAI API key (add it in Settings › AI › Agent). It asks before it pays, sends, posts or deletes; Stop any time.

Pages follow light and dark.title: Pages match light and dark
Pages follow light and dark.detail: Web pages use their Space's light or dark look, and open pages switch at once when it changes, including when macOS switches between light and dark on its own. Background tabs, Peek and Little Airc follow too.

Links open fast when Airc is closed.title: Links open fast
Links open fast when Airc is closed.detail: Click a link in another app while Airc is closed and its page shows in about a second, even on the first launch (it used to take up to 6 seconds). Blocking still applies to the page from its first request.

Airc Agent (beta) gets better.title: Airc Agent (beta) improves
Airc Agent (beta) gets better.detail: Replies stream in as they're written, and the approval card shows in Watch too. Turn on memory in Settings › AI › Agent, type a task in the Command Bar with "Ask Airc to…", or hand it to your Claude app.

Every launch is quick now.title: Every launch is quick
Every launch is quick now.detail: About every other launch used to wait up to a second inside macOS before Airc started, so a link from another app could take almost two seconds. That wait is gone with the Chromium engine, the default.

Search suggestions from your imported se.title: Imported engines suggest
Search suggestions from your imported se.detail: Search engines you brought over from Arc, Chrome or Brave now suggest as you type after ⌘T, like the built-in ones: your default, and a shortcut once you pick it with Tab. Not in private windows; turn suggestions off in Settings › Privacy.

\"New ChatGPT Message\" from the second.title: Ask command from 2 letters
\"New ChatGPT Message\" from the second.detail: The Command Bar now shows "New ChatGPT Message" (or "Ask Claude…") from the second letter you type, so your first keystroke after ⌘T stays fast.

Command Bar fixes.title: Command Bar fixes
Command Bar fixes.detail: The Ask rows stay put while you type after ⌘T. "Ask This Page…" works on every page or says why, and "Ask Airc to…" shows even before you add an API key and opens the agent's setup.

WebKit's first launch is fast too.title: Fast first launch: WebKit
WebKit's first launch is fast too.detail: With the WebKit engine, a link opened on Airc's very first launch now shows in about a second instead of four: the blocking rules come ready to use.

Boosts sync between your Macs.title: Boosts sync
Boosts sync between your Macs.detail: With iCloud sync on, your Boosts follow you to your other Macs. Their JavaScript runs only after a quick confirm on each Mac. Turn it off in Settings › Sync › Sync Boosts.

The first launch after an update is a li.title: Quicker after updates
The first launch after an update is a li.detail: Airc now starts a downloaded update once in the background before it restarts, so macOS's first-run checks are already done. You'll notice it from the next update on.

Notification sounds stay out of the side.title: Quiet notification sounds
Notification sounds stay out of the side.detail: Short pings from pages such as WhatsApp or Slack no longer pop up the sidebar's mini player. Music and videos still get their player as before.

Copy Quote Link, like Arc.title: Copy Quote Link
Copy Quote Link, like Arc.detail: Select text on a page, then choose Copy Quote Link in its right-click menu or click Share Quote under the address. The link opens the page right at that text, highlighted.

The Agents folder tidies itself.title: Tidier Agents folder
The Agents folder tidies itself.detail: Rows in the sidebar's Agents folder now say what an agent did, like "Gmail · read 3 pages", and finished ones close after 5 minutes. Change that in Settings › Agents › Keep finished agents for.

Security: Airc now asks every app or scr.title: Every app asked once
Security: Airc now asks every app or scr.detail: Airc now recognises apps and scripts by what actually runs, not the name they give, and asks each one once before it can use the browser. Some apps you allowed before are asked once more; see them in Settings › Agents.

Run the Airc Agent on your own Claude Co.title: Agent on your Claude Code
Run the Airc Agent on your own Claude Co.detail: In Settings › AI › Agent › Use, choose Your Claude Code or Your Codex: the Airc Agent then runs your installed copy with its own login and only Airc's browser tools.

Password-manager extensions work better.title: Better password managers
Password-manager extensions work better.detail: 1Password's Unlock button now opens its popup, and Proton Pass, Bitwarden and 1Password popups open at full size. In Settings › Passwords you can let your password manager's extension save and fill logins instead of Airc.

Dark mode works.title: Dark mode for all of Airc
Dark mode works.detail: In Settings › Appearance › Airc, choose Auto to follow your Mac, or Light or Dark for windows, the sidebar, Settings and every page. Spaces follow it unless you gave one its own look.

Import from Dia.title: Import from Dia
Import from Dia.detail: Choose Dia in Airc › Import from Another Browser… to bring its profiles, bookmarks, history and extensions. With the Chromium engine, allow macOS to use Dia's key once and your passwords, cookies and sites' data come too.

Rules for each connected app.title: Rules for connected apps
Rules for each connected app.detail: In Settings › Agents › Apps, Rules… sets the one profile an app may use and sites it may never open. Agents upload only from folders you allow, and their downloads stay out of your list.

Agents tell you when a page needs you.title: When a page needs you
Agents tell you when a page needs you.detail: When an agent reaches a sign-in page or a captcha, its row in the Agents folder says Needs you and Airc sends a notification. Open it and Take over to sign in.

Your password manager fills logins on it.title: Password manager autofill
Your password manager fills logins on it.detail: Turn off Offer to save and fill passwords in Settings › Passwords, and Airc no longer fills a saved login when a page loads, so your password manager's extension does it instead.

Granola starts notes for your calls.title: Granola notes for calls
Granola starts notes for your calls.detail: When a Meet, Zoom, Teams, Webex or Whereby tab turns on your microphone, Airc can start a Granola note, once per call. Turn it on in Settings › General › Calendar (shown when Granola is installed).

Security update: Airc's Chromium engine.title: Chromium security update
Security update: Airc's Chromium engine.detail: Airc's Chromium engine is now 156.0.8078.109, with Chrome's latest security fixes. Nothing to do: this update installs it.

The Airc Agent opens beside the page.title: The agent beside the page
The Airc Agent opens beside the page.detail: Press ⌥⌘A and the Airc Agent opens next to your page. While it works, you see the page it's on, live, above the conversation.

Watch any working agent from the sidebar.title: Watch from the sidebar
Watch any working agent from the sidebar.detail: Hover over a working task in the sidebar's Agents folder and click the eye to watch its page live.

Search in Settings.title: Search in Settings
Search in Settings.detail: Press ⌘F in Settings, or type in the field at the top of its sidebar. Pick a result to jump to that setting, highlighted.

Settings stays put.title: Settings stays put
Settings stays put.detail: Switching panes in Settings no longer moves the layout: every pane keeps the same column, and Appearance no longer shifts left.

The Stop button in the agent pane shows.title: Stop shows in dark Spaces
The Stop button in the agent pane shows.detail: While the Airc Agent works, the round Stop button next to its message field is now visible in dark Spaces too.

Developer Tools dock inside the window y.title: DevTools in the window
Developer Tools dock inside the window y.detail: Press ⌥⌘I and Developer Tools open beside the page in the same window, at the bottom or the side; ⇧⌘D switches. Every panel works, including the » list and right-click menus.

The agent pane can set up your own Claud.title: Set up Claude Code, Codex
The agent pane can set up your own Claud.detail: In the agent pane (⌥⌘A), Install… shows the command to install your own Claude Code or Codex, and Sign in… starts its own sign-in. Hand back gives the agent the same tab.

The agent pane uses far less power while.title: A lighter agent pane
The agent pane uses far less power while.detail: While the Airc Agent is thinking, its pane now uses almost no CPU, so long tasks cost far less battery.

Your saved passwords and cookies are saf.title: Saved logins stay safe
Your saved passwords and cookies are saf.detail: If macOS can't unlock the keychain, Airc asks you to Try Again instead of starting over. Your saved passwords and cookies stay, and they're back once the keychain opens.

Every window can be closed.title: Close any window
Every window can be closed.detail: With the sidebar hidden, move the pointer to a window's top-left corner and its close button appears. ⌘W on a window's last tab closes the window, as in Arc.

Typing in the Command Bar is quicker.title: A quicker Command Bar
Typing in the Command Bar is quicker.detail: Each keystroke in the Command Bar (⌘T) does less work, and the first one after opening it no longer waits, so results keep up with your typing.

New profiles get a short setup: pick the.title: A short new-profile setup
New profiles get a short setup: pick the.detail: After Create Profile (a Space's Set Profile › New Profile…), pick a colour for the Space and sign in to Google in the new profile. The card then shows your account and closes.

Your account's picture and name show up.title: Your account, right away
Your account's picture and name show up.detail: After you sign in, including from the sidebar's Sign in to Google card, your account's picture and name show beside the Space name, in Set Profile › and in Settings › Profiles, without a relaunch.

When Claude uses Airc, its notice no lon.title: Window buttons stay clear
When Claude uses Airc, its notice no lon.detail: While Claude or another AI app uses Airc, the sidebar shows "✦ Claude is using Airc" just under the window's buttons, never over them. Click it to Watch or Stop the app.

New ✦ button opens Airc Agent.title: Airc Agent, one click away
New ✦ button opens Airc Agent.detail: The new ✦ button at the bottom of the sidebar opens Airc Agent, or press ⌥⌘A. Right-click it for New Task, Watch or Settings › Agents.

Connect your AI right in the pane, with.title: Connect AI in the pane
Connect your AI right in the pane, with.detail: In Airc Agent (⌥⌘A), Connect your AI: your own Claude Code or Codex, or an API key. Keys stay in your Mac's Keychain.

Play Spotify in a Chromium tab with Fair.title: Spotify plays in Chromium
Play Spotify in a Chromium tab with Fair.detail: Turn on Settings › Privacy › Protected content › Play protected media in Chromium with FairPlay (off by default): Spotify stays in a Chromium tab with your extensions.

Use your ChatGPT subscription in Airc Ag.title: Your ChatGPT subscription
Use your ChatGPT subscription in Airc Ag.detail: In Airc Agent (the ✦ button or ⌥⌘A), Connect your AI now starts with your ChatGPT subscription: connect your own Codex with Sign in with ChatGPT. Your own Claude Code or an API key work too.

Netflix and Disney+ play in a Chromium t.title: Netflix and Disney+
Netflix and Disney+ play in a Chromium t.detail: Turn on Settings › Privacy › Protected content › Play protected media in Chromium with FairPlay (off by default): Netflix and Disney+ stay in a Chromium tab and play with Apple's FairPlay.

A faster Chromium engine.title: A faster Chromium engine
A faster Chromium engine.detail: Airc's Chromium engine is now built the way Chrome is, so windows are ready sooner after launch, busy pages use less CPU and Airc takes about 200 MB less space.

Sites you type in are no longer blocked.title: Typed sites not blocked
Sites you type in are no longer blocked.detail: A site you type or open from a bookmark, such as analytics.google.com, no longer shows "blocked by Airc" in Chromium tabs. Trackers inside pages stay blocked.

Google Tag Assistant and Tag Manager pre.title: Google tag tools work
Google Tag Assistant and Tag Manager pre.detail: On Google's Tag Assistant, Tag Manager and Analytics, Airc lets Google's tag scripts through so preview and debug mode connect. Everywhere else they stay blocked.

Spotify opens in Airc's Safari engine, w.title: Spotify in Safari engine
Spotify opens in Airc's Safari engine, w.detail: Spotify now always opens in Airc's Safari engine, where its player works. Netflix and Disney+ still play in Chromium with the FairPlay setting, and Airc offers Safari's engine if a site can't play.

The Command Bar answers your first keyst.title: Faster first keystroke
The Command Bar answers your first keyst.detail: Airc prepares the Command Bar while you're idle, so the first letter you type after ⌘T shows sooner.

Airc Agent tasks get their own view.title: Agent tasks, full view
Airc Agent tasks get their own view.detail: Open a task from the Agents folder to see every step, what it found and the agent's page live; reply or approve from there. ✦ or ⌥⌘A opens the compact pane.

⌘T can Ask as well as Search.title: Ask from ⌘T
⌘T can Ask as well as Search.detail: Press ⌘T, type what you want done and press Tab to ask the Airc Agent. Recent tasks show as cards under the field.

The ✦ button now sits in the toolbar.title: ✦ in the toolbar
The ✦ button now sits in the toolbar.detail: The Airc Agent button is now at the top of the sidebar, next to Back and Forward. Click ✦ or press ⌥⌘A to open the agent.

Share Quote appears inside the address b.title: Share Quote in address bar
Share Quote appears inside the address b.detail: Select text on a page and Share Quote slides in at the end of the address bar. Nothing in the sidebar moves any more.

The Feedback button stays visible howeve.title: Feedback always in view
The Feedback button stays visible howeve.detail: The speech bubble at the bottom of the sidebar stays there with many Spaces; the Space icons get narrower instead, as in Arc.

Little Airc windows come back properly f.title: Little Airc, Stage Manager
Little Airc windows come back properly f.detail: A Little Airc window now comes to the front when you choose it in Stage Manager, Mission Control or the Dock, and it is listed in the Window menu.

When an agent needs you, one click takes.title: Needs you, in one click
When an agent needs you, one click takes.detail: When an agent waits for you, click its notification, its Agents row, ✦ or the Dock icon to go straight to its question or page. The live page in the pane no longer flickers.

Fewer sites blocked by mistake.title: Fewer false blocks
Fewer sites blocked by mistake.detail: Sites you open yourself, such as sentry.io, no longer show "blocked by Airc" because a tracker list names them. Trackers inside pages stay blocked.

When Today gets long, Airc offers once a.title: A tidy card for Today
When Today gets long, Airc offers once a.detail: When Today gets long, a card at its top offers to archive old tabs or pin a site in one click, with Undo. Not now hides it until tomorrow.

Tidy shows its folders before it moves a.title: Undo for Tidy and Clear
Tidy shows its folders before it moves a.detail: With Apple Intelligence, Tidy shows its folders first, with Apply and Cancel. Clear says how many tabs it archived. Undo or ⌘Z puts them back.

Ask Airc Agent about something you read.title: Agent finds earlier pages
Ask Airc Agent about something you read.detail: Press ⌥⌘A or ✦ and ask about a page you saw or a tab you have open. Airc Agent searches this profile's history and tabs, and shows what it searched.

Finished agent tasks keep their pictures.title: Task pictures stay
Finished agent tasks keep their pictures.detail: The page pictures in a finished agent task's steps are still there after you quit and reopen Airc.

⌘Z after a Clear undoes the whole Clear.title: One ⌘Z undoes a Clear
⌘Z after a Clear undoes the whole Clear.detail: After a Clear, ⌘Z or the toast's Undo puts every tab back in one step, even in a long session, and no longer reopens a closed Peek instead.

When Airc Agent asks for your OK, a Retu.title: Safer agent approvals
When Airc Agent asks for your OK, a Retu.detail: When Airc Agent asks for your OK, a Return typed into a web page no longer approves it. Only the request itself does.

\"Needs you\" from a task you started wi.title: Needs you, right window
\"Needs you\" from a task you started wi.detail: When a task you started with Ask in ⌘T needs you, its request opens in the window and Space where you started it.

Fixes: a small memory leak when closing.title: Fixes
Fixes: a small memory leak when closing.detail: A closed window's Share Quote button no longer keeps running, and Netflix or Disney+ no longer show a false "couldn't play here".

Airc reads newer auto-archive settings s.title: Safer settings sync
Airc reads newer auto-archive settings s.detail: An auto-archive time that a newer Airc on another Mac syncs is read safely, instead of breaking your settings.
